$comment: The docs site's settings. Everything that names the product or decides who can read the docs lives here, so a rebrand is this file plus the four --dx-brand-* colours in shared/docs-tokens.css. docs/how-to-write-docs.md explains each line.

email.$comment: Who the platform's emails come from. fromName: the name people see. fromAddress: account mail (sign-up, password reset, email change, client onboarding), on the portal's own subdomain clearway.verxyl.com (registered in Resend 2026-11-02). Until that domain is verified, Resend refuses it and the send goes again from fallbackAddress, which works today (verxyl.com is verified): nothing is blocked while DNS is added. The wall's alerts come from alerts@clearway.verxyl.com (digital-wall/lib/mailer.mjs); intake keeps agent@verxyl.com, because it receives mail. Nobody reads no-reply@, so no email asks for a reply. lib/mail/send.ts.
